notes.title: New from Alike Studio: All of You is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to share some news from the Alike Studio team! 🎉
[/p][p]Our game [b]All of You[/b] has just launched on [b]Steam[/b].

If you loved [i]Bring You Home[/i], you’ll feel right at home with this cute and clever adventure.

In [i]All of You[/i] you’ll:
🐣 [b]Pause and resume time[/b] to solve puzzles
🐣 [b]Help a brave hen rescue her lost chicks[/b]
🐣 Explore dozens of surprising, fun, and emotional levels

It’s charming, family-friendly, and full of the humor and creativity you already know from [i]Bring You Home[/i].[/p][p]
👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636860/All_of_You/"]Check out All of You on Steam now[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37256620/a76e37c69c9761a83a32f4e5ca231312179d361b.png"][/img]Thank you so much for playing our games and supporting us! We can’t wait for you to meet the chicks! 💛[/p]
